question: Which uniformly colored offerings are forbidden to the virtuous addressee?
premises: All-black items are not to be given.
All-yellow items are not to be given.
The instruction is addressed to the virtuous one.
inference: All-black and all-yellow offerings must not be given.
uncertainties: the object is implied as garland or flower offering from context
plain_english: O virtuous one, what is entirely black or entirely yellow must not be offered to me.
